title: Piece of Heart — Lost Woods Skull Kid
how: Stand on the stump near the Kokiri Forest entrance and play Saria's Song for the Skull Kid.

title: Piece of Heart — Lost Woods Memory Game
how: Beat the Skull Kids' ocarina memory game three rounds in a row, near the target tree.

title: Piece of Heart — Lon Lon Ranch Tower
how: Inside the ranch tower: move the crates and crawl through the gap to a hidden room.

title: Piece of Heart — Hyrule Field Business Scrub
how: Blow open the hidden hole just outside Castle Town and buy it from the Business Scrub. A Fairy Note gives the password.

title: Piece of Heart — Hyrule Field Hidden Chest
how: A chest under large rocks near the Gerudo Valley arch. Read the Fairy Note as Adult Link, then collect it as Young Link.

title: Piece of Heart — Castle Town Lost Dog
how: At night, find the white dog Richard in Castle Town and bring him back to his owner in the back alley.

title: Piece of Heart — Treasure Chest Shop
how: A prize in the Treasure Chest Shop game, open at night. The Lens of Truth makes it easy.

title: Piece of Heart — Bombchu Bowling
how: One of the Bombchu Bowling Alley prizes.

title: Piece of Heart — House of Skulltula
how: Reward for bringing 50 Gold Skulltula Tokens to the cursed family in the House of Skulltula.

title: Piece of Heart — Kakariko Windmill
how: On the ledge inside the windmill, reached from the turning platform.

title: Piece of Heart — Potion Shop Roof
how: Talk to the man sitting on the blue roof by the windmill. Glide over with a Cucco, or Hookshot onto the vines.

title: Piece of Heart — Kakariko Rooftop
how: On the rooftop where Kaepora Gaebora drops you after flying you down from Death Mountain.

title: Piece of Heart — Dampé's Gravedigging
how: At night, pay Dampé to dig in the graveyard's soft soil until he turns up something hard.

title: Piece of Heart — ReDead Grave
how: Push the second-row tombstone on the far right at night, drop in, and play the Sun's Song to reveal the chest.

title: Piece of Heart — Graveyard Ledge
how: On the high ruins in the graveyard. Plant a Magic Bean in the soil there as Young Link and ride the flower as Adult Link.

title: Piece of Heart — Dampé's Race
how: Race Dampé through his tomb again and finish in under a minute.

title: Piece of Heart — Above Dodongo's Cavern
how: In an opening above the Dodongo's Cavern entrance. Ride the Magic Bean flower planted just outside.

title: Piece of Heart — Goron City Spinning Pot
how: Light the torches around the big pot, then drop a lit bomb into it from above to stop it on the right face.

title: Piece of Heart — Crater Cliff
how: Climb down the netting on the cliff straight ahead as you enter the crater from the trail.

title: Piece of Heart — Crater Volcano
how: Plant a Magic Bean by the warp pad as Young Link, then ride the flower as Adult Link to the piece in the smoke.

title: Piece of Heart — Crater Business Scrub
how: Buy it from the Business Scrub on the lower ledge on the left.

title: Piece of Heart — Zora's River Platform
how: On a raised platform partway up the river. Glide there with the Cucco from the Hyrule Field end.

title: Piece of Heart — Zora's River Waterfall
how: On a high ledge near the waterfall at the top of the river. Carry the Cucco up and glide across.

title: Piece of Heart — Frogs (Song of Storms)
how: Play the Song of Storms to the frogs on the log.

title: Piece of Heart — Frogs Ocarina Game
how: Win the frogs' ocarina game after growing all five frogs with your songs.

title: Piece of Heart — Zora's Domain Torches
how: Light every torch around the waterfall to make a chest appear.

title: Piece of Heart — Zora's Fountain Ice
how: On the farthest of the floating ice platforms in the frozen fountain.

title: Piece of Heart — Zora's Fountain Floor
how: On the bottom of the fountain near the Ice Cavern entrance.

title: Piece of Heart — Fishing Pond
how: Catch a big fish (about 55 cm or more) in the Fishing Pond and show it to the owner.

title: Piece of Heart — Lakeside Laboratory Dive
how: Dive to the bottom of the laboratory tank, then talk to the scientist.

title: Piece of Heart — Laboratory Rooftop
how: On top of the laboratory tower. Ride the Magic Bean flower planted outside.

title: Piece of Heart — Gerudo Valley Ledge
how: On a small ledge on the far cliff, left of the bridge. Glide over with a Cucco.

title: Piece of Heart — Gerudo Valley Waterfall
how: Behind the waterfall: drop to the ledge below and follow the path north.

title: Piece of Heart — Gerudo's Fortress Rooftop
how: In a chest on the fortress's highest roof.
needs: Longshot, or Hookshot with the Scarecrow's Song

title: Piece of Heart — Horseback Archery
how: Score 1,000 points or more in the Gerudo horseback archery game.

title: Piece of Heart — Desert Colossus Rock Arch
how: On the rock arch near the Spirit Temple. Plant a Magic Bean as Young Link and ride the flower as Adult Link.

title: Gold Skulltula — Kokiri Shop Bug Hole

title: Gold Skulltula — Zora's Domain Entrance
how: On the northwest wall by the Zora's Domain entrance. Only at night.

title: Gold Skulltula — Zora's River Bean Ride

title: Gold Skulltula — Zora's Domain Waterfall
how: At the top of the waterfall, left of the diving game.

title: Gold Skulltula — Zora's Fountain Golden Tree
how: In the tree outside the Great Fairy Fountain.

title: Gold Skulltula — Zora's Fountain Ruins

title: Gold Skulltula — Zora's Fountain Cave
how: On the top vines of the hidden Skulltula cave. Only at night.

title: Gold Skulltula — Lake Hylia Hidden Cave

how: In the bug hole by the Lakeside Laboratory door.

title: Gold Skulltula — Lake Hylia Island Tree
how: At the top of the tree on the central island. Only at night.

title: Gold Skulltula — Gerudo Valley Bridge
how: Under the plank bridge at the valley entrance. Only at night.

title: Gold Skulltula — Gerudo Valley Bug Hole
how: In the bug hole near the Gerudo guard.

title: Gold Skulltula — Carpenters' Camp Arch
how: On the arch column at the carpenters' camp. Only at night.

title: Gold Skulltula — Carpenters' Tent

title: Gold Skulltula — Gerudo's Fortress West Door

title: Gold Skulltula — Horseback Archery Range
how: By the farthest target of the horseback archery range. Only at night.

title: Gold Skulltula — Haunted Wasteland Temple

title: Gold Skulltula — Colossus Rock Wall

title: Gold Skulltula — Colossus Bean Ride
how: Ride the Magic Bean flower to the second rock. Only at night.

how: By the ruined gate outside Ganon's Castle.

title: Big Poe — Castle Road Sign
how: Behind the stone Hyrule sign just outside Castle Town, on the road to Lon Lon Ranch. Ride Epona and jump the spot to make it appear, then shoot it down and bottle it. Sell it to the Poe Collector in Castle Town.
needs: Epona, Fairy Bow, an empty bottle

title: Big Poe — Castle Moat
how: Along the moat, just right of the Castle Town exit. Ride Epona and jump the spot to make it appear, then shoot it down and bottle it. Sell it to the Poe Collector in Castle Town.
needs: Epona, Fairy Bow, an empty bottle

title: Big Poe — Ranch Road
how: Farther along the Lon Lon Ranch road, near the ranch entrance, by the fence with a purple lantern. Ride Epona and jump the spot to make it appear, then shoot it down and bottle it. Sell it to the Poe Collector in Castle Town.
needs: Epona, Fairy Bow, an empty bottle

title: Big Poe — East of the Ranch
how: By a glowing overturned trunk on the east side of Lon Lon Ranch. Approach from the south. Ride Epona and jump the spot to make it appear, then shoot it down and bottle it. Sell it to the Poe Collector in Castle Town.
needs: Epona, Fairy Bow, an empty bottle

title: Big Poe — Gerudo Valley Incline
how: East of Gerudo Valley, by the low glowing wall on the incline to its entrance. Birds circle nearby. Ride Epona and jump the spot to make it appear, then shoot it down and bottle it. Sell it to the Poe Collector in Castle Town.
needs: Epona, Fairy Bow, an empty bottle

title: Big Poe — West of the Ranch
how: Along the outside of Lon Lon Ranch's western wall, roughly level with the ranch's water tower. Ride Epona and jump the spot to make it appear, then shoot it down and bottle it. Sell it to the Poe Collector in Castle Town.
needs: Epona, Fairy Bow, an empty bottle

title: Big Poe — South of the Ranch
how: South of Lon Lon Ranch, between the ranch fence and the Deku Scrub woods, by a ghostly branch with a lantern. Ride Epona and jump the spot to make it appear, then shoot it down and bottle it. Sell it to the Poe Collector in Castle Town.
needs: Epona, Fairy Bow, an empty bottle

title: Big Poe — Lake Hylia Wetlands
how: East of the Lake Hylia entrance, by a fallen tree near the wetlands. Ride Epona and jump the spot to make it appear, then shoot it down and bottle it. Sell it to the Poe Collector in Castle Town.
needs: Epona, Fairy Bow, an empty bottle

title: Big Poe — Southwest of the Ranch
how: Where the dry southwestern part of Hyrule Field meets the grassland, near the ruined tower at Lon Lon Ranch. Ride Epona and jump the spot to make it appear, then shoot it down and bottle it. Sell it to the Poe Collector in Castle Town.
needs: Epona, Fairy Bow, an empty bottle

title: Big Poe — Hill South of Kokiri Forest
how: On the hillside just south of the path into Kokiri Forest. Ride Epona and jump the spot to make it appear, then shoot it down and bottle it. Sell it to the Poe Collector in Castle Town.
needs: Epona, Fairy Bow, an empty bottle
